_note: Inbox rows that look like his problem and are not. `node tools/mail.mjs inbox` marks a row that matches a rule and prints it under its own Filtered heading at the end, so the brief and the close-out never turn one into a line for him. Every field given in a rule must match: `from` and `subject` are case-insensitive substrings of the sender address and the subject; `notTo` fires only when the To: line is known and does NOT include that address (a copy addressed to somebody else). Tariq's own rule of 11 Sep 2026: low-value mail goes to a quarantine list, not the bin, so filtered rows keep their number and `read <n>` still opens them.
